title: $1,000 in Amazon in 1997 is now worth this
caption:
Amazon listed its shares in May 1997, when it mostly sold books.
$1,000 at the first day's closing price would be worth about {growth:AMZN:1997-05-15} today (share price only, no dividends).
comment: Which stock do you wish you'd bought years ago? 👇
sources: Amazon.com share price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In nineteen ninety-seven, Amazon was an online bookstore.

clip.text: Online bookstore lists on the stock market

scenes.say: Imagine putting one thousand dollars into its shares on day one.
Today, that would be worth about {growth:AMZN:1997-05-15}.
Patience paid more than any tip ever could.
